title: Power Man and Iron Fist #75 Marvel 1981 Double-Sized Return to K'un-Lun Bronze
condition_description: Bright, glossy painted cover with light handling wear; back cover toned. See photos.
description:
Power Man and Iron Fist #75 (November 1981), Marvel Comics - Special Double-Sized Spectacular, "Return to K'un-Lun!" Master Khan, the H'ylthri, and the reveal that Miranda Rand-K'ai was Iron Fist's half-sister. Written by Mary Jo Duffy, pencils by Kerry Gammill; painted cover by Bob Larkin. Columbia ten-speed contest banner. 75 cent cover price.

Back cover: LEGO Expert Builder Challenge #8860 Auto Chassis ad.

Condition: bright, glossy painted cover with light handling wear; back cover toned (see photos).

Ships bagged in a protective mailer.
